verdict.rationale: ADK ships its own tool confirmation (human-in-the-loop) flow that can gate tool execution behind explicit confirmation. That restricts what an agent may do, but only as approval gating, not a documented fine-grained permission model. There is no evidence of sandboxed execution: code execution is mentioned without any isolation, and container deployment is a host-platform feature, not a product sandbox. missing for 10: fine-grained per-tool permission/allowlist policies, sandboxed or isolated code/tool execution, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can restrict what an agent may do with fine-grained tool permissions and sandboxed execution

citations.quote: Tool Confirmation: A tool confirmation flow (HITL) that can guard tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input.
